name: Orca
tagline: Hum, sing or beatbox an idea, say how it should sound, and get back editable music.
problem: Many enthusiasts have melodies in their heads but no instrument or production skill to turn them into music.
solution: One voice recording carries both the musical idea and spoken instructions ("make this a piano"); an agent pipeline transcribes the melody to MIDI, applies the instructions, adds backing parts and returns a track the artist can edit in a MIDI editor.
demo_moment: Team-described: hum a melody, ask for a piano with a guitar backing, and play the result.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Keeps the artist in control: instructions and melody in the same recording, output editable.
Hum-to-song is a live moment judges can try themselves.

lessons: A demo the judges can perform with their own voice is hard to forget.
